mathematical_argument: Let \(D_r(S)\) be the complete set of distinct legal original-plus-decorated placement keys incident to unfilled row \(r\) in state \(S\). For two literal keys \(k_1\ne k_2\), independently rebuilding each under unchanged language epoch, full marking and authority and verifying whole current legality proves \(k_1,k_2\in D_r(S_1)\). Hence \(\lvert D_r(S_1)\rvert\ge2\). No statement that \(D_r(S_0)=D_r(S_1)\) is needed.

For each witness \(c_i\), check \(T_{S_1}(p)+t_{c_i}(p)\le1\) on all its positive support and \(m_{S_1}(p)=m_{c_i}(p)\) at every jointly assigned mark point. Absence stays distinct from explicit zero. Exact selected/excluded full-key membership and strict-prior ports are checked as well.
The witnesses are alternatives: they need not be mutually compatible, and \(t_{c_1}+t_{c_2}\) is never added to the state. Collision ledgers are merged as identity evidence, not as a point union.

For old/new/exposed census maps \(C_0,C_1\), require \(C_0(x)=C_1(x)\) whenever the same ID \(x\) is present in both, with complete literal preimages. A growing domain of IDs does not invalidate the two refreshed witnesses. Any differing preimage is an error, never UNKNOWN pruning. This checks all actually exposed identities; it does not presume injectivity or enumerate hidden never-exposed internal fibres.

The conclusion permits only TWO_OR_MORE. If fewer than two cached witnesses remain legal, neither \(\lvert D_r(S_1)\rvert=0\) nor \(\lvert D_r(S_1)\rvert=1\) follows; other candidates may exist. Recompute that row normally.
minimal_check_sequence: Check original17/input2 full semantic authority, language binding/epoch, fixed marking and current Source identity separately; freshly validate complete before/after original and marked states. Require exact row int0..23 and unfilled positive total in both. Old origin must be the engine-owned exact preceding-context association, not a copied header.

Form one transaction-local full census from old/new state inventories, all already owned exposed/provider/cursor ledgers and the witness rebuilds. Compare every common ID/preimage literally in both directions; preserve all original/decorated IDs even if a candidate later fails legality. Do not drop rejected exposure history before committing the new state.

For each eligible old MANY or TWO_OR_MORE row, choose exactly two checked full keys and full old packets. Independently rebuild each complete native original/decorated packet in the new fixed model; compare complete key and old core excluding only read_obligations. Validate native membership and literal point arrays through existing independent primitives; do not use a fibre digest, old cover flag or prior EOF as this check.

Check each witness individually against the complete new t/m maps, selected/excluded full sets and both-ID census. Changed output/read/metadata/remote/channel4 points must be freshly compared; a changed read occupancy is refreshed as factFalse. Do not skip a remote point because the row or viewport appears unaffected.

If two distinct legal keys survive, emit only the distinct current lower-bound receipt. If the row filled or either witness is definitely illegal, do not retain its degree classification; use the unchanged normal fresh query. Malformed membership/core/identity/authority and native/tick errors propagate, rather than being relabelled as zero or a learned absence.

No retained origin is itself current completeness authority. Full before/after literals, origin packet and new packets/census are retained for joins; hashes supplement those literals. A later transfer must again freshly check its two current witnesses.
